description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Research Scientist, Life Sciences based in the United States. 

 We are looking for a research scientist to strengthen the scientific foundations of innovative AI-powered technologies for clinical research. This role combines expertise in psychiatry, psychology, behavioral science, and clinical research with emerging applications of artificial intelligence and machine learning. You will design and conduct applied studies to evaluate the validity, reliability, and clinical value of new approaches to clinical assessment and automated monitoring. You will also lead scientific publications, contribute to conference presentations, and collaborate with pharmaceutical sponsors and research partners on research and development initiatives. Working closely with scientific, clinical, technical, and commercial teams, you will translate research findings into practical requirements and credible scientific evidence. This is a full-time remote opportunity offering significant scientific ownership and the ability to influence an evolving field.



Accountabilities
 

 
 Design and conduct applied research evaluating the validity, reliability, and clinical utility of AI-powered technologies used in clinical research.



 
 Develop research protocols, validation methodologies, analysis plans, and scientifically grounded interpretations of study findings.



 
 Apply rigorous clinical and behavioral science methods to research involving clinical outcome measures, automated monitoring, assessment tools, and emerging AI/ML capabilities.



 
 Define scientific data requirements, reference standards, and research specifications to support technical development and downstream validation.



 
 Lead and contribute to peer-reviewed manuscripts, conference abstracts, scientific presentations, and research reports.



 
 Collaborate with pharmaceutical sponsors and external research partners to design and execute research and development initiatives and publish results.



 
 Translate research findings into case studies, white papers, and scientific materials demonstrating the evidence and capabilities of clinical research technologies.



 
 Support the preparation of scientific content for sponsor proposals, research protocols, technical reviews, and scientific assessments.



 
 Work closely with clinical researchers to support research execution, clinical assessment methodology, annotation quality, and scientific collaboration.



 
 Partner with machine learning and data science teams to define clinical requirements, prepare labeled datasets, establish reference standards, and support technical validation.



 
 Collaborate with life sciences leadership, customer delivery, marketing, and business development teams to address sponsor needs and communicate scientific findings.



 
 Contribute to research priorities and publication planning while maintaining independence in day-to-day research activities under the guidance of the Chief Scientific Officer.




 Requirements:


 
 4+ years of experience in psychiatry, psychology, behavioral science, clinical research, or a closely related discipline.



 
 Advanced research training in psychology, psychiatry, behavioral science, or a related field.



 
 Demonstrated record of peer-reviewed scientific publications and conference presentations.



 
 Familiarity with clinical outcome measures, psychometrics, assessment validation, and clinical research methodologies.



 
 Experience designing, conducting, or contributing to applied research and scientific validation studies.



 
 Understanding of emerging AI and machine learning applications in clinical research, with the ability to translate scientific concepts into practical research requirements.



 
 Experience with clinical trials and collaboration with pharmaceutical sponsors or external research partners on applied research and development.



 
 Strong scientific writing, analytical reasoning, research design, and interpretation skills.



 
 Ability to work independently, manage research priorities, and maintain scientific rigor while meeting practical project timelines.



 
 Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively across clinical, scientific, technical, and commercial teams.



 
 Adaptability and curiosity, with an interest in advancing evidence-based applications of AI in clinical research.



 
 Candidates with different combinations of clinical research, behavioral science, psychometrics, pharmaceutical research, and applied AI experience are encouraged to apply, even if they do not meet every listed qualification.




 Benefits:


 
 Annual salary range of $120,000–$150,000.



 
 Full-time employment.



 
 Fully remote position based in the United States.



 
 Significant scientific ownership and independence in day-to-day research activities.



 
 Opportunity to lead and contribute to peer-reviewed publications, conference presentations, and applied research initiatives.



 
 Close collaboration with scientific leadership, clinician researchers, machine learning specialists, and pharmaceutical research partners.



 
 Opportunity to contribute to emerging AI applications that aim to improve clinical trial quality, assessment, and monitoring.
